formula: z = direction × (value − 4); score = mean(z) × 100 / 3; rightPercent = 50 + score / 2

followup.eligibility: Only complete preceding stages; target exactly the axes whose unrounded rightPercent is in inclusive [40,60].
followup.scoring: Pool base and supplemental answers with equal weight within each axis; unchanged deadband. All supplemental items on an axis must be numeric before showing its pooled score.
followup.stopping: Stop when no axis is borderline or after two rounds. Preserve X if still in the middle interval; incomplete stages do not advance.
followup.interpretation: Exploratory follow-up, not validated adaptive testing, higher confidence, or an independent retest. Different selected axes, rounds, modes and item sets are not equivalent forms.

totalType: Only shown when every item has a numeric answer; incomplete runs have type XXXX.
pairConsistency: 100 × (1 − mean(|z_pair1 − z_pair2|)/6). Descriptive response-pattern diagnostic, not psychometric reliability.
keyVisibility: The item keys are public in source. The questionnaire JSON omits them to reduce priming, not to provide secure blinding.
